codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly delivers all three required artifacts: (1) scripts/install_ghidra.py — a well-structured, idempotent installer that downloads with progress, extracts with zip-slip protection, verifies the headless launcher, and cleans up the archive; (2) external/ghidra-server/ghidra_http_server.py — updated with a resolve_ghidra_path() function that prefers external/ghidra-dist/ghidra_12.0.4_PUBLIC/ and falls back to external/ghidra/; (3) tests/unit/test_ghidra_install.py — 4 focused tests covering idempotence, extraction flow, path preference, and fallback behavior. The installer uses only stdlib, has proper CLI args, and the server changes are minimal and backwards-compatible. external/ghidra/ was NOT modified. All expected behaviors are met.

issues.description: The entire Ghidra 12.0.4 binary distribution (5155 files, ~2.8M lines of insertions, ~500MB+) was committed to git in external/ghidra-dist/. The .gitignore file does NOT contain an entry for external/ghidra-dist/ (whereas external/ghidra/ IS gitignored). This permanently bloats the repository. The installer script exists specifically to download the distribution on demand, making the committed files redundant. An 'external/ghidra-dist/' entry should be added to .gitignore, and the tracked files should be removed from git history or at minimum from the working tree index.

No SHA-256 checksum verification of the downloaded archive. The installer trusts whatever bytes it receives from the URL. For a security-focused tool downloading ~500MB, adding a hardcoded expected hash and verifying after download would improve supply-chain safety.

No retry logic for the ~500MB download. If the network drops mid-transfer, the partial .part file is deleted on next attempt but the user must manually re-run. A retry with backoff (even 1-2 retries) would improve reliability for such a large file.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker committed the entire Ghidra binary distribution (5155 files, ~500MB) to git without adding external/ghidra-dist/ to .gitignore. AGENTS.md and the coding conventions don't explicitly state that large binary downloads should be gitignored, which may have contributed to this oversight.

summary: PASS. The ghidra-binary-install feature is correctly implemented with a clean, idempotent installer script, proper path-preference logic in the HTTP server, and 4 focused unit tests. All expected behaviors (idempotence, headless launcher verification, path preference with fallback) are verified. The main concern is that the entire ~500MB Ghidra binary distribution (5155 files) was committed to git without a .gitignore entry for external/ghidra-dist/, which permanently bloats the repository. This is flagged as non-blocking since the feature requirements are met and the distribution is functional, but it should be addressed in a follow-up.
